verdict.rationale: Together AI is an API-first platform that runs headlessly: a server-side TypeScript SDK, an OpenAI-compatible REST API that needs only an API key and base URL, a batch API for async workloads, and a `tg` CLI that can deploy endpoints and launch fine-tuning jobs. These are scriptable surfaces suited to automation pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI integration guidance (e.g. GitHub Actions examples or non-interactive auth/secrets setup), the deploy CLI command is still under `beta`, and no independent hands-on evidence of CI use.
